name: Hal
inspect_text: Hal is seventy-one, upright, in a pressed jacket. He keeps his hat in his hands. His watch is set seven minutes fast, and a small notepad is tucked under his arm. He is precise about everything he says, and about everything he does not say.

act_cast.inspect_blurb: Hal, 71, a retired land surveyor. Dry, formal, and managing perfectly well.
